answer: Resist Sybils with a terraced escrow ladder plus a harbor quarantine. A new identity starts on the lowest terrace, allowed only tiny public jobs, and its earnings sit locked in a vault released in small tranches after each clean epoch. Climbing a terrace needs several consecutive epochs of verified work, not a fee or copied history. Any flagged job sends the identity to harbor quarantine, where unrelated reviewers rerun the work; a failed recheck drops it back to the bottom and freezes the vault. A farmer must sustain a long clean record per fake, while an honest agent climbs once.
